Why choose Mdluli Safari Lodge?
Mdluli Safari Lodge sits inside Kruger National Park, offering Big 5 sightings without leaving the property. Rooted in successful land reform and community upliftment, it pairs eco-conscious tented accommodation , an infinity pool and boma dining with genuine, values-led hospitality – a distinctive alternative to standard luxury lodges.
Where is Mdluli Safari Lodge located?
Mdluli Safari Lodge is located inside the south-western region of Kruger National Park , about a 5-hour drive from Johannesburg. Unlike lodges in private reserves bordering the Park, Mdluli sits directly within Kruger’s fenceline, so wildlife can be seen right from the lodge.
What accommodation does Mdluli Safari Lodge offer?
Mdluli Safari Lodge offers 50 custom-designed, 70sqm tents blending eco-conscious design with safari-style luxury. Each includes an oversized patio, private indoor and outdoor shower, king or twin bed, mini bar fridge and Wi-Fi. Four tents are disability-friendly, and the lodge is fully wheelchair accessible.
What activities can guests enjoy at Mdluli Safari Lodge?
Guests can enjoy many experiences , including guided or self-drive Big 5 game drives, boma dinners, a signature infinity pool and a granite rock viewpoint with 360-degree Park views. Additional experiences include gin-tasting, bush braais and Amani spa treatments, suiting both active and relaxed itineraries.
Who is Mdluli Safari Lodge suited for?
Mdluli Safari Lodge suits families , couples , solo travellers and small groups . Tents sleep two adults and two children under 12, and the lodge also hosts special events like bush weddings and conferences. Wheelchair-accessible tents and flexible packages make it suited to a wide range of guests.

Location
Kruger National   Park
Location
Inside the heart of   the Kruger
You’ll find us inside the Kruger National Park, not far from Pretoriuskop Rest Camp.
Drive: 5-hours drive from Johannesburg. Fly: 45-minute shuttle from Kruger Mpumalanga International Airport (KMIA), 1 hour 30 minutes from Skukuza Airport.
Once inside the Park, the lodge is easily accessed through a private road near the Numbi Security & Control Point. From there, it’s approximately 6km/20 minutes drive to reach the lodge main gate. Look out for sightings en route!
Numbi Gate is the nearest entry gate to us. All guests are required to adhere to gate opening and closing times.
View the pinned location on Google Maps.
Book Your Stay
Enquire Now
Location
Park Gate   entry options
We are located in the south-western region of the Kruger National Park, not far from Pretoriuskop Rest Camp. Once inside the Park, the lodge is easily accessed via a sign-posted private road from the Numbi Gate Security and Control Point. Guests are welcome to choose their preferred Park entry gate.
Numbi, Malelane, Phabeni and Kruger Gates all offer convenient access, with a scenic drive and potential sightings along the way to the lodge.
Approximate drive times from Gauteng:
Numbi Gate: 4.5 hours to the Park, approximately 20 to 30 minutes to the lodge once inside the Park
Malelane Gate: 4 hours to the Park, approximately 3 hours to the lodge once inside the Park
Phabeni Gate: 5 hours to the Park, approximately 45 minutes to the lodge once inside the Park
Kruger Gate: 5.5 hours to the Park, approximately 2 hours to the lodge once inside the Park
Conservation fees will be payable (per person, per vehicle registration number) when entering the Park. Guests may make use of their Wildcard.
Contact our team for any further information in planning your trip.

Our Story | Luxury Tented Lodge | Mdluli Safari Lodge
Our story
Feel good and   leave something good behind
Kuhamba kubona   Traveling opens one’s eyes
– Siswati proverb
A story born from successful land reform, the lodge has been recognised as a blueprint for best practice community development projects in South Africa.
Mdluli Safari Lodge fills a unique gap for anyone looking for a luxury safari experience inside the Kruger National Park. Whether you’re a first-time or life-time Kruger visitor; whether it’s the thrill of a Kruger adventure that excites you, or you’re seeking a tranquil escape – our lodge is a firm favourite for South African and international travellers.
We want our guests to leave our gates relishing their memories, and knowing that their stay leaves a lasting positive impact.
Read More
Our Story
How it   all began
We opened our doors to guests in January 2020.
Our lodge is built on three interlinked pillars: community partnership ; conservation impact ; environmental sustainability . It’s taken decades of dedication to achieve the realisation of this lodge. A development like this is dependent on establishing a harmonious relationship between community, environment and tourism.
We are proud to be in partnership with the Mdluli Community. Today, the Community has freehold title of these 850 hectares of land inside the iconic Kruger National Park. More than 90% of our lodge team are from the Mdluli Community.
